description: This file defines an interface named OnFoldListener which provides callback methods for folding events: start and end of folding, used in a folding layout component.

classes.name: OnFoldListener
classes.description: An interface for listening to folding state changes, with methods for start and end of fold events.

methods.name: onStartFold
methods.description: Callback invoked when the folding layout begins folding, transitioning from unfolded to folded state.

methods.name: onEndFold
methods.description: Callback invoked when the folding layout finishes unfolding, transitioning from folded to unfolded state.
